name: housekeeping: clear ?mode=inline from the webview URL
description: splash-random-abilities navigates the webview to ?mode=inline, and a plain reload PRESERVES the query string - so any later app-view test would boot into the inline splash and time out waiting for the lobby. This clears it and confirms the normal expanded app comes back.

steps._comment: Expanded mode again: App renders the real game, not SplashCourt.
